changelog: `apm marketplace outdated` lists local-path entries such as `source: ./` as skipped instead of failing a git ls-remote (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: apm marketplace outdated ran git ls-remote for a local source: ./ entry, printed a [x] ls-remote failure row and then reported that all packages were up to date, while apm marketplace check treated the entry as OK.

owner: src/apm_cli/commands/marketplace/outdated.py (uses MarketplacePackageEntry.is_local, the same predicate apm marketplace check uses)
notes: Local entries now render an [i] row 'Local path; skipped' and never reach RefResolver. Out of scope and unchanged: a remote entry whose ls-remote fails still renders [x] while the summary says all packages are up to date and the exit code stays 0. Docs: reference/cli/marketplace.md outdated section notes local entries are skipped. Unit test mock in tests/unit/commands/test_marketplace_outdated.py now sets is_local=False explicitly.
